sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Middle-aged man in close bust turned slightly toward screen right, short grey temple hair under a tall navy cloth cap with red edging, narrow yellow zigzags, green stripe and navy folded crown with hanging tail at screen right. Dark brows, clean-shaven chin and upper lip, closed downturned mouth. Navy coat with colored shoulder stripes and deep red inner neck cloth; muted pale grey-beige painted background. Preserve the full backing, serious look and cap folds; adapt to a short broad mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Man facing slightly screen left with eyes further left, short dark side-parted combed hair, dark eyebrows and a thick black moustache with clean chin. Closed neutral mouth, black suit jacket, ivory pointed shirt collar and dark brown tie. Close bust, warm softly shaded face, full muted light grey-beige painted backing. Retain moustache and hair, no extra beard, short broad collar fit.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older man three-quarter toward screen right, receding silver-grey side-parted hair, grey brows and compact grey moustache, clean chin and serious closed downturned mouth. Olive military jacket with grey shirt and dark olive tie, small gold buttons and dark shoulder tab. Cropped bust against full pale grey-beige painted backing; preserve subdued light and short broad fitted neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older moustached man nearly front facing with gaze up toward screen left. White peaked naval cap with dark band, ornate gold crest and gold embroidery on black visor; grey hair at sides, long drooping silver moustache, clean chin. Dark navy uniform with small gold collar emblems and shoulder insignia, grey shirt and dark tie. Full softly shaded pale grey-beige painted backing; preserve all visible cap decoration without inventing tiny text and keep short broad neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older man in strong screen-right three-quarter profile, brushed-back wavy dark grey hair, dark eyebrows and large silver handlebar moustache with raised curling ends, clean chin. Olive military coat, grey shirt and dark tie, red-and-gold collar patches and small gold shoulder detail. Serious closed mouth, close bust and full pale grey-beige painted backing; match profile, whiskers and compact neck transition.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older man nearly front facing slightly toward screen right, receding combed-back dark hair grey at temples, grey brows and grey moustache, clean chin, closed restrained mouth. Olive army jacket with small gold buttons and shoulder trim, grey-green shirt and black tie. Full pale grey-beige painted backing and soft light; retain moustache only and short broad collar fit.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older man turned slightly screen right with swept side-parted silver hair, thick grey eyebrows, large white-grey handlebar moustache and full bushy beard. Serious closed mouth mostly bounded by moustache. Olive army coat with red shoulder boards and gold trim, grey shirt and olive tie; full pale grey-beige painted backing. Preserve full beard, hair, shoulder boards and short broad neck under beard.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-front man with dark brown side-parted hair, heavy brows, thick black moustache and full dark beard, solemn closed mouth. Dark olive high-collared tunic with a central round gold button and gold shoulder boards; no visible tie or separate shirt collar. Cropped bust, pale muted grey-beige full painted backing, soft directional light. Preserve beard, closed high collar and compact broad neck with no invented exposed neck column.
